    print(f"  {cls}: {trips_cnt} trips, {yt_tot} yt")

# Compare S1 vs S2
df_trips = tables['trips']

    yt_tot = df['yt'].sum()
    yt_per_trip = yt_tot / trips_cnt if trips_cnt > 0 else 0
    print(f"\nSeason {season}:")
    print(f"  Total trips: {trips_cnt}")
